objective: Measure actual local RTC/VAD/STT/planning/tool/TTS behavior before claiming a live voice demonstration.
model_policy: Pinned local Qwen, Parakeet and Kokoro; localhost LiveKit transport; no hosted model or judge.

phrases.correct: Actually, go to the office instead.

input_assets.generation: Generate after cache ablation, freeze WAV hashes and source before transport trials. Generated user speech is independent of agent output; no acoustic echo path.

cases.trigger: after agent session_started, with audio subscription handler already registered; record track subscription time separately
cases.expected_response: Grounded route result delivered as received audio after observed navigation success.

cases.trigger: After initial substantive result event AND received non-silent agent PCM, publish correction while result playback is still observed. Acknowledgment alone cannot trigger.
cases.expected_response: Old result playback is interrupted, correction is transcribed, office route starts, and final result describes office. Initial airport effect was already completed and is not classified as stale.

measurements: Record published input frame schedule and end of generated speech separately from trailing silence.
Save raw coordinator data events, server traces, all dispatch log entries, worker/server logs and every received audio-frame arrival timestamp and PCM.
Measure input speech end to finalized transcript, acknowledgment, first substantive received non-silent audio, tool dispatch and effect.
Report input correction onset and VAD-speaking/finalized-transcript boundaries separately from observed cessation of old received audio.
Frame-arrival/PCM activity is a transport observation, not physical audible-stop latency. Do not silently concatenate away gaps when presenting a timeline.
Wait through session readiness and response completion with explicit deadlines; retain failed or truncated trials.
limits: Development synthetic speech, not held-out FDB or human driving evidence.
No claim about microphone echo cancellation, road noise, WAN latency or physical loudspeaker playback.
No extra silence or altered capture applied to official benchmark input.
False-barge-in and non-speech probes require a separate predeclared follow-up after baseline capture can verify trigger/timing fidelity.
decision: Do not claim full-duplex support from unit or text tests; inspect actual received audio, events and all effects before conclusions.
